lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in approximately six near-vertical columns; spacing between columns is roughly 1.5 to 2 times the cluster diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher luminance intersect the circular blobs, forming a grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear features exhibiting a vertical luminance gradient (bright upper edge, dark lower edge) running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank.

other_distinctive_markers: An elongated, dark, high-aspect-ratio feature is visible ventrally to the pectoral fin, oriented parallel to the shark's longitudinal axis.
